q: How did God reveal his plan of salvation?
a: God’s plan of salvation was revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus.

q: What is Timothy to do with the good deposit God has committed to him?
a: Timothy is to guard through the Holy Spirit the good deposit God has committed to him.

q: What is able to strengthen Timothy?
a: The grace that is in Christ Jesus can strengthen Timothy.

q: In the last days, what will people love instead of God?
a: In the last days, people will love themselves and love money instead of God.

q: In the last days, what other thing will people love instead of God?
a: In the last days, people will love pleasure instead of God.

q: For what is all Scripture profitable?
a: All Scripture is profitable for teaching, reproof, correction, and training in righteousness.
